过年时，一家人团聚，共享天伦之乐。
At New Year the family gathers to share the joys of home.

m: A **virtuous** person full of **kindness**: **good and kind** (of a wife).
ex: 他的妻子很贤惠。
His wife is kind and capable.
她是一个贤惠的好妈妈。
She is a kind and caring mother.

m: Tie the **knot** on the **account**: **to pay the bill**.
ex: 服务员，结账！
Waiter, the bill please!
我们吃完饭去前台结账。
After eating we paid at the front desk.
多穿点，别着凉。
Wear more; don't catch a cold.
昨晚没盖被子，我着凉了。
I didn't use a blanket last night and caught a chill.
请对着麦克风说话。
Please speak into the microphone.
麦克风没有声音了。
The microphone has stopped working.

m: **Weighs** up to the **heart**, **as** you **intend**: **just as one wishes**.
ex: 祝你称心如意！
May everything go just as you wish!
他找到了一份称心如意的工作。
He found a job that's just what he wanted.
新生明天报到。
New students register tomorrow.
他第一天到公司报到。
He reported for his first day at the company.

m: **Money** to **press down** the **years**: **New Year money** for children.
ex: 过年的时候，孩子们拿压岁钱。
At New Year, children get lucky money.
爷爷给了我两百块压岁钱。
Grandpa gave me 200 yuan of New Year money.
use: Often in red envelopes, 红包.

m: **Without** **reason**, **taking up** a **noisy** fuss: **to make trouble for no reason**.
ex: 你别无理取闹了。
Stop making a fuss over nothing.
他总是无理取闹，大家都很烦。
He's always kicking up a fuss for no reason, and everyone's fed up.
这家店的东西物美价廉。
The things in this shop are good value.
这台电脑物美价廉，很受欢迎。
This computer is good and cheap, so it's very popular.
你有零钱吗？
Do you have any change?
我把零钱都放在小钱包里。
I keep all my change in a little purse.
劳驾，让一下。
Excuse me, let me through.
劳驾，请问火车站怎么走？
Excuse me, how do I get to the train station?
这个问题真伤脑筋。
This problem is a real headache.
孩子不爱学习，父母很伤脑筋。
The child doesn't like studying, which gives the parents a headache.
这次演出空前绝后。
This performance was unprecedented and unrepeatable.
那是一场空前绝后的大雪。
That was a snowstorm like no other.

m: A **heart** to go **up** and **forward**: **ambition** to improve.
ex: 他很有上进心。
He's very motivated.
这个孩子缺乏上进心。
This child lacks the drive to improve.
我买了一斤桔子。
I bought half a kilo of tangerines.
桔子又甜又好吃。
Tangerines are sweet and delicious.

m: Mount **Tai** and the Big **Dipper**: a **leading authority**.
ex: 他是中医界的泰斗。
He is a leading authority in Chinese medicine.
这位老先生是音乐界的泰斗。
This old gentleman is a giant of the music world.
这个项目要进行招投标。
This project will go to tender.
公司参加了政府的招投标。
The company took part in a government tender.
请把垃圾扔进垃圾桶。
Please throw the rubbish in the bin.
垃圾桶满了，该倒了。
The bin is full; it needs emptying.

m: **Sugar** on fruit shaped like a **gourd**: **candied haws on a stick**.
ex: 冬天我最爱吃糖葫芦。
In winter I love eating candied haws.
街上有人在卖糖葫芦。
Someone is selling candied fruit sticks on the street.
use: Measure word 串; a Beijing street snack.

ex: 森林里有很多飞禽走兽。
There are many birds and animals in the forest.
这本书介绍了各种飞禽走兽。
This book introduces all kinds of birds and beasts.
这孩子太娇气了。
This child is too soft.
别那么娇气，一点小伤没关系。
Don't be so delicate; a little scratch is nothing.
他获得了比赛的季军。
He came third in the competition.
我们队拿了季军。
Our team took third place.
use: 冠军, 亚军, 季军: first, second, third.

ex: 我的车在车库里。
My car is in the garage.
这栋房子有一个大车库。
This house has a big garage.
use: 地下车库, underground car park.

ex: 请给我一把叉子。
Please give me a fork.
我不会用筷子，用叉子吧。
I can't use chopsticks; I'll use a fork.
这部电影有中文字幕。
This film has Chinese subtitles.
看字幕可以帮助学中文。
Watching with subtitles can help you learn Chinese.
use: Measure word 行 for a line.

m: **Draw** a **snake** and **add** **feet**: **to spoil something by adding more**.
ex: 这句话是画蛇添足。
This sentence is unnecessary and spoils it.
文章已经很好了，别画蛇添足。
The essay's already good; don't overdo it.
礼拜天你有空吗？
Are you free on Sunday?
我们礼拜天去公园玩。
We're going to the park on Sunday.
用胶水把它粘上。
Stick it on with glue.
胶水用完了，再买一瓶吧。
The glue is finished; buy another bottle.
冬天要穿羽绒服。
In winter you need a down jacket.
这件羽绒服又轻又暖和。
This down coat is light and warm.
他工作很勤恳。
He works very diligently.
老王勤恳地工作了三十年。
Old Wang worked conscientiously for thirty years.
他们举行了追悼会。
They held a memorial service.
人们来追悼这位英雄。
People came to mourn this hero.

m: A **nail** spiralled like a **shell** with **silk** thread: a **screw**.
ex: 这里少了一颗螺丝钉。
A screw is missing here.
他说要做一颗永不生锈的螺丝钉。
He said he wants to be a screw that never rusts.
use: Measure word 颗; famous slogan about loyal service.

ex: 这个词有贬义。
This word has a negative meaning.
“小气”是一个贬义词。
"Stingy" is a derogatory word.
use: Opposite: 褒义; 贬义词, pejorative.

m: **Moisten** yourself in another's **light**: **to benefit from** someone.
ex: 我也跟着你沾光了。
I got some of the benefit through you too.
他哥哥是老板，他也跟着沾光。
His brother is the boss, so he gets some benefit too.
饺子是什么馅儿的？
What filling are the dumplings?
我最喜欢猪肉白菜馅儿。
I like pork and cabbage filling best.
use: Spoken; 露馅儿, to give the game away.

ex: 谢谢你们的深情厚谊。
Thank you for your deep friendship.
两国人民之间有深情厚谊。
There's a deep friendship between the two peoples.
他们终于苦尽甘来了。
After all their hardship, things have finally got better.
别灰心，总会苦尽甘来的。
Don't lose heart; good times will come after the hard ones.
大家一起使劲儿！
Everyone push together!
他使劲儿推门，门还是不开。
He pushed the door hard, but it still wouldn't open.

m: **Make** yourself the **east** seat, the host: **to treat**, be the host.
ex: 今天我做东。
Today it's my treat.
他做东，请大家吃饭。
He played host and treated everyone to dinner.
上课前要预习。
You should prepare before class.
我昨天晚上预习了新课文。
Last night I read through the new lesson beforehand.
他是一名足球解说员。
He's a football commentator.
博物馆的解说员讲得很好。
The museum guide explained things very well.
他今天旷课了。
He skipped class today.
旷课太多会被学校处分。
Skipping too many classes will get you disciplined by the school.
这是一件次品。
This is a defective item.
商店不能卖次品。
Shops can't sell substandard goods.
他在路边摆了个摊儿。
He set up a stall by the road.
这个水果摊儿的东西很新鲜。
The fruit at this stall is very fresh.
use: 摆摊儿, to run a street stall.

m: **Full** of **experience** of seas turning into **mulberry** fields: **weathered by life**.
ex: 老人饱经沧桑。
The old man has lived through a lot.
他那张饱经沧桑的脸让人难忘。
His weathered face is unforgettable.
请出示您的登机牌。
Please show your boarding pass.
我在手机上拿到了登机牌。
I got my boarding pass on my phone.
祝你有锦绣前程！
Wishing you a bright future!
他放弃了锦绣前程，回到了家乡。
He gave up a brilliant future and went back to his hometown.

m: **Pull up** **sprouts** to **help** them **grow**: **to spoil things by haste**.
ex: 教育孩子不能拔苗助长。
You can't rush children's development.
这样学习是拔苗助长。
Studying like this is forcing things too fast.

m: **Know** what is **enough** and be **always** **happy**: **contentment brings happiness**.
ex: 奶奶常说知足常乐。
Grandma often says that being content is happiness.
他是一个知足常乐的人。
He is a contented, happy person.
我给你留了一张便条。
I left you a note.
他在桌上写了个便条。
He wrote a note on the table.
我忘带充电器了。
I forgot my charger.
能借我用一下充电器吗？
Could I borrow your charger?
我的行李箱太重了。
My suitcase is too heavy.
请把行李箱放在这里。
Please put the suitcase here.

m: **Put out** a **foreign** **appearance**: **to make a fool of oneself**.
ex: 他在台上出洋相了。
He made a fool of himself on stage.
我不想在大家面前出洋相。
I don't want to embarrass myself in front of everyone.
我很纳闷儿，他为什么没来。
I'm puzzled why he didn't come.
她纳闷儿地看着我。
She looked at me, puzzled.
对不起，无可奉告。
Sorry, no comment.
记者问他，他只说无可奉告。
When the reporter asked, he only said "No comment."
他总是丢三落四的。
He's always forgetting things.
别丢三落四，出门前检查一下。
Don't be scatterbrained; check before you go out.
他说话太啰唆了。
He talks too much.
别啰唆了，快说重点。
Stop rambling and get to the point.
钢笔没墨水儿了。
The pen has run out of ink.
他肚子里有点墨水儿。
He's quite well-read.

m: **Put** down work for the **heat** **holiday**: **to be on summer holiday**.
ex: 学校七月放暑假。
School breaks up for summer in July.
放暑假以后，我想去旅行。
After the summer holiday starts, I want to go travelling.
他致力于环境保护。
He devotes himself to environmental protection.
这家公司致力于开发新技术。
This company is committed to developing new technology.
use: Formal; followed by a noun or verb phrase.
